assignments.name: PreSense blank on Genesys blind transfers
AI agent handoff loses caller details
PreSense routing improves handle time and close rates

steps.summary: Nothing auto-delivered · 3 waiting for a reviewer

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Keystone Mutual · Executive Sponsor Call · October 14, 2026

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** [PERSON_1] (SVP, Distribution & Marketing), Nate Simmons (Director, Contact Center Operations), [PERSON_2] (CSM), [PERSON_3] (RVP, Enterprise Sales)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Semi-annual exec sponsor meeting covered 2027 expansion plans, AI Voice Agent pilot results, and two operational issues Nate raised. [PERSON_1] wants an expansion proposal by mid-January ahead of the February budget close. [PERSON_3] joined for the expansion discussion; [PERSON_2] took the operational items back to the team.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: AI Voice Agent pilot currently handles after-hours claims intake only; 300+ Genesys agents licensed, 420 Invoca seats overall. Nate reported the pilot has been live since July and call containment is tracking where they hoped, though he did not share a specific number.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] said 2027 planning is centered on expanding AI Voice Agent beyond after-hours claims into FNOL and policy servicing. She wants a phased proposal that shows seat impact and expected containment by queue.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] walked through what an expansion proposal would need: current after-hours volumes, target queues, and a rough split of voice vs messaging. He committed to pulling a first draft together with [PERSON_2].

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: 2027 budget cycle closes in February; [PERSON_1] wants the expansion proposal by mid-January so it can go through their internal review. Nate will be the operational point of contact for scoping.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Google Ads and Adobe Analytics integrations are fine; no changes requested. Salesforce and Genesys connections are also stable.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] noted the exec sponsor cadence is working well and asked to keep the semi-annual rhythm through 2027.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: When a call transfers from the sales queue to the service queue in Genesys, the PreSense screen pop on the second agent is blank.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Nate said [PERSON_4]'s claims team gets AI Voice Agent handoffs on after-hours claims without the policy number or loss details it already collected, so adjusters ask again.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] called out PreSense routing as the main reason bind rate on paid search calls is up 9 points since spring.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: If the expansion proposal slips past mid-January, it misses Keystone's February budget close and 2027 expansion could be delayed a full cycle.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: The two operational items Nate raised could slow agent adoption if not addressed before the expansion.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to log the PreSense transfer screen pop issue with the product team and confirm next steps by October 21.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to follow up with Nate on the AI Voice Agent handoff data gap and get specifics on which queues and fields are affected by October 23.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to draft expansion proposal outline and share with [PERSON_2] by November 6.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] and [PERSON_3] to review proposal with [PERSON_1] and Nate in early December, ahead of the mid-January deadline.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to send a recap of today's call to [PERSON_1] and Nate by October 16.
